init.title: Inkbird INT-14-BW options
init.description: Wi-Fi (Tuya LAN) lets Home Assistant read the thermometer over your local network instead of holding the Bluetooth connection, so the Inkbird app stays usable in parallel. Leave the Wi-Fi fields empty to keep using Bluetooth only. Setup guide: README section "Option C: Wi-Fi (Tuya LAN)".

data.wifi_test_on_save: Test the Wi-Fi connection before saving

data_description.temperature_unit: Choose how probe temperatures are reported. "Follow Home Assistant" keeps the device's native °C and lets Home Assistant convert for display.
data_description.transport: Automatic prefers Wi-Fi when it is configured and healthy, and falls back to Bluetooth when the station drops off the network. Wi-Fi only never touches Bluetooth, so the Inkbird app keeps working.
data_description.wifi_host: The station's address on your network. Reserve a fixed IP for it in your router's DHCP settings so it does not change.
data_description.wifi_device_id: Pair the station into the Smart Life app, then copy the device ID from the "Tuya Local Key" Home Assistant add-on (QR login) or the TinyTuya wizard. Not the model name.
data_description.wifi_local_key: Shown next to the device ID by the same tool. It is not your Wi-Fi password and not your Inkbird password. Re-pairing or resetting the station generates a new key.
data_description.wifi_version: Tuya LAN protocol version. 3.5 is correct for the INT-14-BW.
data_description.wifi_port: Leave at 6668 unless you know the station listens elsewhere.
data_description.wifi_poll_seconds: How often Home Assistant asks the station for temperatures. 10 seconds is a good start.
data_description.wifi_test_on_save: Recommended: Home Assistant polls the station once before saving and refuses values that do not connect.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the station over Wi-Fi with these values. Check the IP, device ID, local key and protocol version, and make sure Home Assistant can reach the station's network.
error.wifi_incomplete: Wi-Fi connection needs all three values: station IP address, Tuya device ID and local key.
